sloka: ताभ्याम् स परिपूर्णाभ्याम् भुजाभ्याम् राक्षस अधिपः ।शुशुभे अचल सम्काशः श्र्न्गाभ्याम् इव मन्दरः ॥५-१०-२२॥
transliteration: tābhyām sa paripūrṇābhyām bhujābhyām rākṣasa adhipaḥ ।śuśubhe acala samkāśaḥ śrngābhyām iva mandaraḥ ॥5-10-22॥

translations.english: The lord of demons looked splendid like a mountain with his long, fully developed arms. He appeared like Mandara mountain with two lofty peaks.
